description:
"Fully-charged Inferno Staff Heavy Attacks deal an additional |cffffff7370|r Flame Damage over |cffffff20|r seconds.

Fully-charged Lightning Staff Heavy Attacks damage nearby enemies for |cffffff50|r% of the damage done.

Fully-charged Ice Staff Heavy Attacks grant you a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff3741|r damage. This effect scales off your Max Health.

While an Ice Staff is equipped, blocking costs Magicka instead of Stamina."
